name: 风云之风起云涌
group_note: 风云 (Gu Long novel-themed), two-password (admin + login) registration flow. New finding, catalogued as AGENTS.md §7.60: master.lpc's log_error() -- called for every ordinary compile WARNING, not just real errors -- ends with CHANNEL_D->do_channel(...); if CHANNEL_D hasn't been preloaded yet (true for whichever files sit before it in adm/etc/preload), that call silently triggers a nested compile of channeld.lpc from inside the caller's still-in-progress compile, which this driver forbids -- caught, re-thrown as '*Object cannot be loaded during compilation.', and re-logged through log_error() again, producing tens of thousands of lines of repeated trace dumps for what was originally a harmless pragma warning on the first couple of preloaded files. Bounded to the boot window before CHANNEL_D loads (harmless once boot completes) but drowns real output badly enough to be worth fixing -- guarded with find_object(CHANNEL_D) before the broadcast. Also fixed the classic §8.1 GBK Chinese-name bug in both is_chinese() and check_legal_name() (length bounds + byte-stepping loop, silently rejected every real Chinese name). Formatter's blind-spot-3 check caught 2 genuine corruptions (a wizard-training-quiz text file and a code-cheatsheet file with unescaped trailing Chinese annotations) among 12 flags -- reverted both. Admin (fluffos/Mud@2026) seeded via real registration + adm/etc/wizlist.
